title: 作业许可十问
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/12_Test Your Knowledge of Work Permit System (WPS) Work Permit System (WPS) MCQs Te.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/12_Test Your Knowledge of Work Permit System (WPS) Work Permit System (WPS) MCQs Te/src.py

points.K5: 签发动火许可前查什么
points.S2: 外来人员进实验室要交底
points.S6: 柜下台下维修防别扭姿势

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一张空白作业票，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank work permit form and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天用十道题，弄懂作业许可。

shots.scene: 一行图标：作业票、签字笔、现场检查放大镜、锁
shots.prompt_en: A row of simple icons: a blank permit form, a signing pen, a magnifying glass over a site and a padlock. No people.
shots.narration: 危险的活，先审批、再检查、后动手。

shots.scene: 化学实验室门口，老李背着工具包准备进去
shots.prompt_en: At the door of a chemistry laboratory, the facility engineer arrives with a tool bag.
shots.narration: 老李要进化学实验室，修通风柜排风管。

shots.scene: 老李说只是小活，挥手想直接进
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer waves his hand casually as if the job is small and starts to walk in.
shots.narration: 他想：活不大，一会儿就修好。

shots.scene: 王老师拦住，递上空白作业票
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stops him politely and hands him a blank work permit form.
shots.narration: 王老师拦住他：先办作业许可。

shots.scene: 老周站在实验室里，点头表示配合
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands inside the lab and nods, ready to cooperate.
shots.narration: 实验室负责人老周也来配合。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起三张卡片：受限区域、安全作业、控制措施
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up three cards with icons: a fenced area, a person with a check mark and a shield.
shots.narration: 第一题：为什么要用作业许可？

shots.scene: 受限区域被围栏围起，作业票是通行证
shots.prompt_en: A fenced area with a gate that opens only when a blank permit form is shown. No people.
shots.narration: 管住危险区域里的作业，

shots.scene: 措施清单上的项目逐一打勾
shots.prompt_en: Items on a blank checklist get green checks one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 让控制措施一项项落到实处，

shots.scene: 欣欣点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods.
shots.narration: 安全完成工作，答案是以上都是。

shots.scene: 作业票特写，中间一栏画着盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a blank permit form with a shield icon in the middle section. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：许可里写的安全内容是什么？

shots.scene: 照抄的法规书和通用清单打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A thick law book and a generic checklist are crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 不是照抄法规条文，也不是通用清单。

shots.scene: 针对这项工作的措施清单，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A short checklist tailored to one job, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 是这项活控制风险必须做到的措施。

shots.scene: 四张卡片：射线、火焰、扫帚、管道压力表
shots.prompt_en: Four cards: a radiation symbol, a flame, a broom and a pipe with a pressure gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：哪项活风险低，可以不办？

shots.scene: 射线、火焰、压力管道卡片亮红色
shots.prompt_en: The radiation, flame and pressure pipe cards glow red. No people.
shots.narration: 射线、动火、压力试验，风险高要办。

shots.scene: 扫帚卡片亮绿色
shots.prompt_en: The broom card glows green. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是日常清扫，风险低。

shots.scene: 四张卡片：公司规章、档案盒、盾牌、调查报告
shots.prompt_en: Four cards: a rule book, a file box, a shield and a report with a magnifier. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：作业许可的主要目的？

shots.scene: 档案盒和规章卡片淡出
shots.prompt_en: The file box and rule book cards fade away. No people.
shots.narration: 不是为了应付检查、留存档案。

shots.scene: 盾牌卡片放大
shots.prompt_en: The shield card grows larger and glows. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是防止事故发生。

shots.section_title: 签发动火许可前查什么
shots.scene: 王老师拿着动火作业票，站在实验楼走廊
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank hot work permit in a laboratory building corridor.
shots.narration: 第五题：签发动火许可前查什么？
overlay: 签发动火许可前查什么

shots.section_title: 签发动火许可前查什么
shots.scene: 作业票上接收人签字栏出现签名笔迹图标
shots.prompt_en: A signature scribble icon appears in the receiver box of the blank permit. No people.
shots.narration: 查接收人有没有授权签字，

shots.section_title: 签发动火许可前查什么
shots.scene: 可燃物移走、灭火器到位，逐项打勾
shots.prompt_en: Combustibles removed and a fire extinguisher placed nearby, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 查许可里的措施是否落实，

shots.section_title: 签发动火许可前查什么
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着灭火器站在一旁当看火人
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands nearby holding a fire extinguisher as the fire watch.
shots.narration: 查有没有合格的看火人，三项都要。

shots.scene: 王老师和老李站在通风柜前一起查看
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the facility engineer stand together in front of a fume hood, looking closely.
shots.narration: 第六题：联合现场检查讨论什么？

shots.scene: 三个图标：工作范围框、工具箱、警示三角
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a dashed boundary box, a toolbox and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 干哪些活，用什么设备，

shots.scene: 通风柜里残留试剂瓶的图标闪烁
shots.prompt_en: Icons of leftover reagent bottles inside a fume hood flash yellow. No people.
shots.narration: 有没有影响安全的特殊情况。

shots.scene: 欣欣点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods.
shots.narration: 这三点要在现场当面说清。

shots.scene: 四个区域图标：车间、露天场地、实验室、泵房
shots.prompt_en: Four area icons: a workshop, an open yard, a laboratory and a pump room with flammable liquid drums. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：哪个是受限区域？

shots.scene: 易燃液体泵房亮红色
shots.prompt_en: The pump room with flammable liquid drums glows red. No people.
shots.narration: 原题答案：易燃物料的泵区。

shots.scene: 实验室图标上加一把门禁锁
shots.prompt_en: An access-control lock appears on the laboratory icon. No people.
shots.narration: 可在国内，危化品实验室也实行准入。

shots.scene: 老周开门迎老李进入
shots.prompt_en: The older man opens the lab door for the facility engineer after checking the permit.
shots.narration: 进去作业，要经实验室负责人同意。

shots.scene: 三张卡片：低风险、时钟、硬币
shots.prompt_en: Three cards: a green low-risk gauge, a clock and a coin. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：什么时候可以不办许可？

shots.scene: 时钟和硬币卡片打红叉
shots.prompt_en: The clock and coin cards are crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 时间短、花钱少，都不是理由。

shots.scene: 低风险卡片打勾
shots.prompt_en: The low-risk card gets a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 只有风险确实低，才能免办。

shots.scene: 作业票被撕成两半的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a permit form being torn in half. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：什么情况下取消许可？

shots.scene: 王老师发现灭火器被挪走，叫停作业
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator notices the fire extinguisher has been taken away and raises a hand to stop the work.
shots.narration: 发现不按许可条件做，立即叫停。

shots.scene: 警铃图标和暴雨大风图标
shots.prompt_en: An alarm bell icon beside a storm and strong wind icon. No people.
shots.narration: 遇到紧急情况或恶劣天气，也要取消。

shots.scene: 欣欣点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods.
shots.narration: 答案是以上都是。

shots.scene: 王老师和老李一起在实验室巡查
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the facility engineer walk through the lab together inspecting.
shots.narration: 第十题：谁来做联合现场检查？

shots.scene: 签发人和接收人两个图标握手
shots.prompt_en: Two person icons labeled by a pen and a toolbox shake hands. No people.
shots.narration: 签发人和接收人，一起到现场。

shots.scene: 两人在作业票上分别签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the facility engineer each sign the blank permit form.
shots.narration: 看过同一个现场，再分别签字。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排八个图标前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a row of eight work icons.
shots.narration: 国内对特殊作业实行作业票管理。

shots.scene: 八个图标：火焰、受限空间、盲板、高处、吊钩、插头、铁锹、路障
shots.prompt_en: Eight icons: a flame, a manhole, a blind flange, a ladder, a crane hook, a plug, a shovel and a road barrier. No people.
shots.narration: 动火、受限空间、高处、吊装、临时用电等。

shots.scene: 一本书和图章图标
shots.prompt_en: A closed blank book with a stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 具体按国家标准和本校规定执行。

shots.section_title: 外来人员进实验室要交底
shots.scene: 老周带老李进实验室，指着危险点
shots.prompt_en: The older man walks the facility engineer through the lab, pointing out hazard spots.
shots.narration: 外来人员进实验室，负责人要交底。
overlay: 外来人员进实验室要交底

shots.section_title: 外来人员进实验室要交底
shots.scene: 小研把通风柜里的试剂瓶搬走
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student removes reagent bottles from the fume hood before the repair.
shots.narration: 先清走作业点附近的化学品。

shots.section_title: 外来人员进实验室要交底
shots.scene: 气瓶阀门关闭、管路贴上标签
shots.prompt_en: Gas cylinder valves are closed and the lines are tagged. No people.
shots.narration: 关闭相关气源，标明危险部位。

shots.section_title: 外来人员进实验室要交底
shots.scene: 小研在旁陪同，老李作业
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stays nearby while the facility engineer works.
shots.narration: 作业期间，实验室要有人陪同。

shots.scene: 配电箱开关断开，挂上锁和标签
shots.prompt_en: An electrical switch is turned off, locked with a padlock and tagged with a blank danger tag. No people.
shots.narration: 修设备前，先断开电源和能源。

shots.scene: 老李把钥匙放进自己口袋
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts the padlock key in his own pocket.
shots.narration: 上锁挂牌，钥匙自己保管。

shots.scene: 老李按下设备开关确认不能启动
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses the equipment start button to confirm it does not start.
shots.narration: 动手前试一试，确认真的断开。

shots.scene: 别人去拆锁的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of another hand removing someone else's lock, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别人的锁，谁也不许擅自打开。

shots.scene: 作业票上一个时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon on the blank permit form. No people.
shots.narration: 作业票有有效期，过期要重新办。

shots.scene: 两个工人交接作业票
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer hands the blank permit to another worker at a shift change.
shots.narration: 换人接班，要把票和现场交代清楚。

shots.scene: 作业内容变化，旧票打叉、新票出现
shots.prompt_en: The old permit is crossed out and a new blank permit appears beside a changed task icon. No people.
shots.narration: 地点、内容变了，就要重新办票。

shots.scene: 老李收拾工具，清理现场
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer packs his tools and cleans up the work area.
shots.narration: 完工后清理现场，带走工具材料。

shots.scene: 王老师和老周检查通风柜恢复正常
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the older man check that the fume hood works normally again.
shots.narration: 签发人和负责人检查，设施恢复正常。

shots.scene: 作业票盖上完成图章
shots.prompt_en: A completion stamp is pressed onto the blank permit form. No people.
shots.narration: 确认无误再关票，实验才恢复。

shots.section_title: 柜下台下维修防别扭姿势
shots.scene: 老李蜷着身子钻进通风柜下方的柜体里修管道
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer crouches awkwardly under a fume hood cabinet to reach a pipe, with a red glow on his back and neck.
shots.narration: 钻到柜下台下修管子，姿势很别扭。
overlay: 柜下台下维修防别扭姿势

shots.section_title: 柜下台下维修防别扭姿势
shots.scene: 老李跪在软垫上，用带灯的工具
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer kneels on a soft knee pad and uses a tool with a built-in light.
shots.narration: 垫上护膝垫，用照明和加长工具。

shots.section_title: 柜下台下维修防别扭姿势
shots.scene: 老李站起来伸展腰背
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands up and stretches his back.
shots.narration: 隔一会儿起身，活动腰背和颈部。

shots.section_title: 柜下台下维修防别扭姿势
shots.scene: 拆下的部件放到台面上修理
shots.prompt_en: A removed part is placed on a workbench at waist height for repair. No people.
shots.narration: 能拆下来的，拿到台面上修。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板上作业票、放大镜、锁三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard with icons of a permit, a magnifier and a padlock.
shots.narration: 危险作业先办票，措施写具体。

shots.scene: 签发人和接收人一起到现场的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of the issuer and the receiver walking to the site together. No people.
shots.narration: 双方同到现场，看火人到位。

shots.scene: 撕开的作业票和恶劣天气图标
shots.prompt_en: A torn permit icon beside a storm icon. No people.
shots.narration: 违规、紧急、天气差，立即停。

shots.scene: 交底、上锁、关票三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a pointing hand, a padlock and a completion stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 进实验室要交底，断能上锁，验收关票。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别，身后通风柜运转正常
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of a working fume hood.
shots.narration: 一张票，管住一份危险！
